name: Oasis Voice
description: TTS and streaming STT via oasis-voice sidecar (Piper TTS + Moonshine STT on the lite tier; GPU tiers available on the hosted endpoint).
_contracts_NOTE: We intentionally do NOT declare a `contracts` block here. The openclaw 2026.4.26 loader's `hasRuntimeContractSurface()` flips `startup.sidecar` to false when ANY of speechProviders/mediaUnderstandingProviders/etc. is declared — meaning the gateway never eager-loads the plugin at startup, and it only lazy-loads when a provider lookup hits the registry. For upstream provider plugins (openai, deepgram, etc.) that lazy-load works because they're bundled and the loader has a dedicated path; for our /app/extensions/-mounted plugin it never actually fires. Skipping the contracts declaration makes `startup.sidecar=true`, so register() runs at boot and registerSpeechProvider/registerMediaUnderstandingProvider/registerRealtimeTranscriptionProvider populate the provider registries eagerly. The actual capability resolution still picks us via autoPriority (10) — see speech-provider.ts + media-understanding-provider.ts.

endpoint.description: Base URL of the oasis-voice HTTP server. Default: http://127.0.0.1:8731

tts_voice.description: Default TTS voice passed to oasis-voice (e.g. piper:en_US-lessac-high). Default: piper:en_US-lessac-high

bearer_token.description: Optional Bearer token for hosted/cloud oasis-voice endpoint (CLAW-013+). Not needed for local lite tier.
